data.label: buzz-shadow
data.sensorReads: pulse's Buzz shadow on Loki: delivery checks that did not match, or coverage windows under 100%, over 15 minutes
data.sensorQuery: sum(count_over_time({job="platform-chorus"} |= "buzz." | json | (event="buzz.delivery.shadow" and verdict!="match") or (event="buzz.shadow.coverage" and stored!="0" and pct!="100") [15m]))
